feeds.title: Paramedics World
feeds.description: Paramedics World was founded in 2017 by Sahil Batra, with the sake to provide medical and paramedical information and reference material to the students and the professionals. The Blog is basically devoted to the Paramedical personnel who risk their lives to save the life of other peoples.

feeds.title: SSCOR Blog
feeds.description: Whether you're in a Hospital or EMS setting, this is the place for you. We'll share information on current industry news, tips, as well as the latest and greatest in SSCOR products. Our hope is that this blog is not only informative but a collaborative and open forum for you to share your thoughts on developing opportunities and challenges within your profession.

feeds.title: International Remote Medic Jobs
feeds.description: International Remote Medic Job Vacancies for Paramedics, EMTs,Nurses and Doctors. This site posts job vacancies for remote medics around the world, and is updated daily.

feeds.title: Ambulance Driver Files
feeds.description: By day he is a mild-mannered paramedic, writer and educator. At night, wearing his multi-pocketed EMS pants, he transforms into Ambulance Driver, a trauma-fighting superhero who prowls the dark streets and seamy underbelly of the city in search of little old ladies who have fallen and can't get up.

feeds.title: A Paramedic's Notebook
feeds.description: My collection of learnings that make me a better medic.

feeds.title: The Good, The Bad and The Ugly Paramedic
feeds.description: Growing the good, breaking the bad and undoing the ugly in paramedicine. A blog for medics, EMTs, ambulance personnel and prehospital clinicians for best patient care and paramedic professionalism.

feeds.title: Not-on-my-shift
feeds.description: Paramedic life has its ups and downs. This blog details both. If you see a paramenace in the ambulance service helping folk, spare a thought, it could be me.

feeds.title: Paramedics Unlimited Blog
feeds.description: Paramedics Unlimited (PMU) is the longest running emergency medical standby company with over 37 years of service. We pride ourselves in taking care of our medics and EMT's, who provide exceptional customer service to our clients and highly skilled medical care to our patients.

feeds.title: AmboFOAM
feeds.description: This is a blog for paramedics and ambulance officers everywhere. I have been inspired by the FOAM movement to try to add a similar blog for those of us in the prehospital profession.

feeds.title: A Paramedic's Journey
feeds.description: I am currently working as a part-time paramedic with the ambulance service. I hope that my account of my journey and my work as a paramedic will aid others who wish to follow the same path as well as provide an insight into what paramedics do.

feeds.title: Mile High Ambulance Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Mile High Ambulance. We're here to serve your Medical Transportation, Emergent and Non-Emergent, EMS and Paramedic needs. Our fleet of well-maintained vehicles will get you to your destination safely and on time. Our professional crew is trained to protect your life and we have a great history of trusted transportation trips.

feeds.title: The Band-Aid Blog
feeds.description: A Journey to Becoming a Witch Doctor aka Parmedic. A Blog About Life in Paramedic School. This is going to be a semi-daily blog about my journey into, through, and out of paramedic school here in sunny San Diego County. I will be writing down my thoughts, experiences, lessons learned, and, for anyone that actually wants to glean some information from my journey, some tips for others looking to begin this crazy circus called medic school.

feeds.title: Paramedic Training Spot
feeds.description: Paramedic Training Spot aims to help teens and young adults find accredited schools, search for jobs, and reach their goal of becoming an EMT or paramedic.Paramedic Training Spot provides you with lists of schools, job boards, and salary information pertaining to EMS.

feeds.title: Paramedic Blog
feeds.description: This blog is more written to Paramedics than about Paramedics. My focus is EMS product and industry news.

feeds.title: Irish College of Paramedics
feeds.description: The professional body for irish pre-hospital emergency care practitioners. our mission is to provide a platform for the development of the paramedic profession, for all registered practitioners and those allied professionals with an interest in Pre-Hospital Care, in order to maintain, advance and contribute to the betterment of Pre-Hospital Care provision to the Public.

feeds.title: College of Paramedics Blog
feeds.description: This blog is a collaborative resource that provides best practice, opinions and advice from members, influencers and experts within the sector as well as updates from around the College to highlight the work in which we are involved.
